intended_change: P0 twentieth round (CEO deep audit 2026-08-21): (1) Split prior-art eligibility into four evidenced phases — SOURCE_DATES_COMPLETE / LEGAL_RULE_IDENTIFIED / LEGAL_RULE_APPLIED / ELIGIBILITY_ESTABLISHED. COMPLETE only when all four are evidenced. A populated applicable_rule field is NOT proof the rule was applied. (2) Restrict automatic §102 support to VERBATIM_EXPLICIT_CLAIM_DISCLOSURE and legitimate CLAIM_DEPENDENCY. STRUCTURAL_EQUIVALENT and FUNCTIONAL_EQUIVALENT require a separate LegalCorrespondenceDecision object — setting disclosure_type=EXPLICIT_CLAIM_DISCLOSURE on equivalence must NOT auto-support §102. (3) Cryptographically bind the entire evidentiary assertion in provenance_hash — limitation_id, claim_number, claim_passage, claim_start/end offsets, correspondence_type, disclosure_type, rule, supporting_evidence, technical_relationship, reviewer/attestation, raw_response_hash, source_node_identifier. (4) Add CorrespondenceAttestation object (reviewer_id, role, decision, rationale, timestamp, evidence_hash, attestation_id). No free-form reviewer string may establish legal correspondence for MANUAL_EXPERT. (5) Add adversarial regression tests: all-fields-populated-but-rule-never-applied, equivalence-marked-explicit-by-mistake, evidence-changed-but-hash-unchanged, forged-reviewer, public-availability-vs-publication-date-conflict, jurisdiction/rule mismatch. Every case fails closed. No semantic backdoor. No metadata-as-evidence. No equivalence-as-anticipation.
